details.description: Chronos-Hermes-13b-v2 is a 13-billion-parameter Llama 2 based model created by the community developer Austism, who merged elinas/chronos-13b-v2 and NousResearch/Nous-Hermes-Llama2-13b in a 75/25 ratio. Per the model card, it "offers the imaginative writing style of chronos while still retaining coherency and being capable," producing long, prose-heavy outputs, and follows the Alpaca instruction format ("### Instruction:" / "### Response:"). It is not an official release from Meta, Nous Research or any lab, but a fine-tune merge published on Hugging Face.
advantages: Merges chronos-13b-v2 with Nous-Hermes-Llama2-13b in a 75/25 ratio to combine chronos's imaginative writing style with Nous-Hermes's coherence, per the model card.
The model card states outputs "are long and utilize exceptional prose."
disadvantages: 4,096-token context window, well below more recent chat models.
No benchmark scores are published on the model card.
Not an official model from a named lab; it is a community merge of two other fine-tunes.

notes: This is a community merge (by Austism) of two other Llama-2-based fine-tunes, not a model from a single named lab; 'maker' is set to the merge's author. No benchmark scores were found on the model card or Fireworks page, so evaluations is empty. Catalog facts (4096 max input/output tokens) match the model card's stated context length.
